meta.source_of_truth: C4C-approved eligibility + SAP EKPO/EKKO PO rows + EKPO short text ticket ID

sap_meta.Value: C4C-approved eligibility + SAP EKPO/EKKO PO rows + EKPO short text ticket ID
Parse C4C ticket ID from EKPO.TXZ01 short text
SAP PO item net value = EKPO.NETWR
PO vendor / repairer = EKKO.LIFNR joined to LFA1.NAME1
A SAP parsed ticket is included only when C4C analysis_ticket_base has a matching C4C Ticket ID, with a valid non-customer Service Technician and no excluded status. No PO fallback is used.
Exclude C4C Service Technician values that are blank/unassigned or contain customer plus repair/repairer.

sap_meta.Metric: C4C ineligible parsed SAP PO lines

meta.cost_rule: approved decision-period tickets with approved repair cost > 0; includes invoiced and approved closed; excludes unapproved
meta.chassis_rule: Serial ID -> Chassis Number -> Vehicle Dispatch Serial -> Registered Product -> Product -> Ticket text token
meta.repeated_chassis_rule: repeat buckets and repair-shop repeated chassis use approved decision-period cost tickets; repeated means 2+ eligible tickets
